narration:0:1360001001:1.text: After a long time, you receive a letter from Atalanta inviting you to visit the Remnant Peaks...
narration:0:1360001001:1.source_cn: 久违地，你们收到了阿塔兰忒的信，信中邀请你们前去遗迹群山……

say:3:1360001002:1.text: Ah, the Remnant Peaks! It's been forever since we were here.
say:3:1360001002:1.source_cn: 啊，遗迹群山！好久没回来了，感觉真怀念！

say:4:1360001003:1.text: It really has been ages. If it weren't for Atalanta's invitation...

choice_prompt:53:1360004007.text: Yup, the final name's going to be "Shimmy"! But for now, since it's just a prototype, we're sticking with the duller nickname: Shimmerwing Reinforced Hyperflux Mark II.
choice_prompt:53:1360004007.source_cn: 我已经给它起了个名字，叫“彩虹”！但现在还只是在研阶段，所以我暂时先用小名来称呼。

say:3:1360005001:1.text: Ow, I'm sorry, I'm sorry! Here, take it back...
say:3:1360005001:1.source_cn: 哎哟哟，我错了我错了，这些还给你们，还给你们……

say:4:1360005002:1.text: I only took two lousy rolls of cloth! You really didn't have to hit that hard... Ow...
say:4:1360005002:1.source_cn: 我就拿了两匹破布，至于下这么重的手吗，哎哟……

say:5:1360005003:1.text: Lousy? Lousy?! That's specially crafted waterproof, fireproof, dazzling fabric! I ordered it just for Shimmy!
say:5:1360005003:1.source_cn: 什么破布！那是我专门给彩虹做的防水防火的绚丽油布！

say:6:1360005004:1.text: Let's see... one, two rolls. Phew. Dusty, but the weave's still intact. Thank goodness.
say:6:1360005004:1.source_cn: 让我数数，一匹，两匹……还好，虽然沾了灰，但至少纺织结...

say:9:1360005005:1.text: Hey, you two don't look like members of the Carmine Whispers or the Water Wights. You're just regular folks from Rustport.
say:9:1360005005:1.source_cn: 两位先生，我看你们像是锈锚港的市民，不是血薇帮或者水鬼...

say:10:1360005006:1.text: What made you think you could steal from Hugin?
say:10:1360005006:1.source_cn: 怎么会这么大胆，来偷呼金的布呢？

say:13:1360005007:1.text: Hmph! Isn't it obvious? This must be sabotage! Evil competitors are trying to derail the birth of my beautiful, brilliant daughter, Shimmy!
say:13:1360005007:1.source_cn: 哼，那还用说，肯定是邪恶的竞争对手暗中破坏，企图阻止我...

choice_prompt:14:1360005007.text: Hmph! Isn't it obvious? This must be sabotage! Evil competitors are trying to derail the birth of my beautiful, brilliant daughter, Shimmy!
choice_prompt:14:1360005007.source_cn: 哼，那还用说，肯定是邪恶的竞争对手暗中破坏，企图阻止我美丽的女儿——彩虹的诞生！

say:15:1360005008:1.text: You wouldn't understand, Magister! My Shimmy may still be a prototype, but she's already precious, adorable, and destined for greatness!
say:15:1360005008:1.source_cn: 梅林！你们魔法师是不会懂的！美丽的小彩虹虽然还在孕育中...
say:15:1360005008:1.male: You wouldn't understand, Magister! My Shimmy may still be a prototype, but she's already precious, adorable, and destined for greatness!
say:15:1360005008:1.female: You wouldn't understand, Magister! My Shimmy may still be a prototype, but she's already precious, adorable, and destined for greatness!

say:16:1360005010:1.text: Um, sir, we really have no idea what you're talking about... We just saw some colorful fabric around here and wanted a few rolls...
say:16:1360005010:1.source_cn: 呃，各位，我们真不知道什么彩啊虹啊……我们就是听说这附...

say:17:1360005011:1.text: We saw them earlier when we were unloading cargo at the port earlier. We thought it'd make good lanterns.
say:17:1360005011:1.source_cn: 我们之前在港口装卸，发现有一批挺漂亮的彩色油布要运往工...

say:18:1360005012:1.text: You know how it goes, things get a little damaged during shipping, right? We figured no one would mind if we "lost" a bit of your goods this time... didn't think we'd get caught...
say:18:1360005012:1.source_cn: 平时装卸偶尔也有损耗嘛，这次也让你们的货“损耗”一点点...

say:19:1360005013:1.text: "Wear and tear", sure, but what you did was straight-up theft!
say:19:1360005013:1.source_cn: 损耗是长途运输时无法避免的折损，你们这根本就是来偷！

say:20:1360005014:1.text: But... lanterns, you say? Are you making them for the Emberlight Festival too?
say:20:1360005014:1.source_cn: 但是，彩灯……难道你们也是为了过春焰庆吗？

choice_prompt:21:1360005014.text: But... lanterns, you say? Are you making them for the Emberlight Festival too?
choice_prompt:21:1360005014.source_cn: 但是，彩灯……难道你们也是为了过春焰庆吗？

say:22:1360005015:1.text: In the legend, mortals used colorful lanterns to lure the beast out, and after it fled, they used them to light up the night.
say:22:1360005015:1.source_cn: 啊，传说里提到，凡人用彩灯诱惑巨兽出现，又在巨兽离去后...

say:23:1360005016:1.text: Beautiful lanterns became a tradition for the festival... But to think you poor lads from Rustport even know how to celebrate the Emberlight Festival. What a surprise!
say:23:1360005016:1.source_cn: 各种漂亮的灯也算是节日传统了……但锈锚港里这帮穷小子竟...

say:26:1360005017:1.text: U-uh, sorry, Master Hugin... I might've let it slip during idle chatter...
say:26:1360005017:1.source_cn: 抱、抱歉，呼金工匠，应该是我之前闲聊的时候说漏了……

say:27:1360005018:1.text: It's just—the Emberlight legend you told was so incredible! Growing up, all I ever heard were pirate tales. This was the first story that felt... epic.
say:27:1360005018:1.source_cn: 您讲的春焰庆传说实在是太精彩太有意思了，我从小只听过海...

say:28:1360005019:1.text: I couldn't help but share it with people when I was drinking in the city.
say:28:1360005019:1.source_cn: 所以回城里喝酒的时候，忍不住就给认识的人讲了。

say:31:1360005020:1.text: My brothers heard about it, and soon my younger siblings were crying for lanterns.
say:31:1360005020:1.source_cn: 我是听兄弟们聊到，然后几个弟弟妹妹就哭着喊着要彩灯。

say:32:1360005021:1.text: As for me... it's my girlfriend. Well, she hasn't said yes yet, but she said she wanted something pretty to decorate with, so I thought, why not...
say:32:1360005021:1.source_cn: 我是女朋友——咳咳，虽然现在她还没答应——她说想要漂亮...

say:33:1360005022:1.text: Hah! It's great to see folks honoring tradition, but these fabrics? They're Shimmy's skin! I can't just hand them over!
say:33:1360005022:1.source_cn: ……呃嗯，愿意遵循传统是好事，但是！这些彩布是小彩虹的...

say:34:1360005023:1.text: However... I can spare a few <style="highlight">lanterns</style> for you so you can join in this grand, beautiful celebration!
say:34:1360005023:1.source_cn: 但是——仍然，但是！我可以分给你们几盏<style=h...

say:35:1360005024:1.text: Nate! Fetch a few cages of lanterns for these lads!
say:35:1360005024:1.source_cn: 奈普，你去把灯拎几笼给他们！

say:38:1360005025:1.text: M-me?! You want me to get those things? Ah... alright, I'll be right back...
say:38:1360005025:1.source_cn: 呃，啊……这……这个……好吧，我马上就回来。

choice_prompt:39:1360005025.text: M-me?! You want me to get those things? Ah... alright, I'll be right back...
choice_prompt:39:1360005025.source_cn: 呃，啊……这……这个……好吧，我马上就回来。

say:40:1360005026:0.text: You'll see. They'll exceed your expectations; they're like nothing you've ever seen before!
say:40:1360005026:0.source_cn: 看见就明白了，绝对超出你的想象，前所未有！
say:40:1360005026:0.male: You'll see. They'll exceed your expectations; they're like nothing you've ever seen before!
say:40:1360005026:0.female: You'll see. They'll exceed your expectations; they're like nothing you've ever seen before!

say:41:1360005028:1.text: Anyway, once you've got the lanterns, all you'll need is a hollowed-out lampshade and some wire—
say:41:1360005028:1.source_cn: 等你们拿到我专门选择的灯，只需要挑个镂空工艺的灯罩，然...

say:43:1360005029:1.text: As Hugin enthusiastically describes his lantern designs, a shriek cuts through the air!
say:43:1360005029:1.source_cn: 呼金刚兴致勃勃地描绘起他的灯笼设计，远处突然传来了惨叫声！

say:45:1360005030:1.text: You hear frantic footsteps getting closer...
say:45:1360005030:1.source_cn: 紧接着，一阵狂奔的脚步越来越近……

say:46:1360005031:1.text: No no! Hugin, sir!! Your lanterns have escaped and started biting people!
say:46:1360005031:1.source_cn: 不不不不，不好啦！！呼金大人！！！您的“灯笼”跑了出来...

choice_prompt:47:1360005031.text: No no! Hugin, sir!! Your lanterns have escaped and started biting people!
choice_prompt:47:1360005031.source_cn: 不不不不，不好啦！！呼金大人！！！您的“灯笼”跑了出来，开始咬人了！！！

say:48:1360005032:1.text: W-what?! Quick! Round them up and bring them back here—NOW!
say:48:1360005032:1.source_cn: 什、什么？！快点，快点把它们抓回去！

choice:47:2:3.text: Of course Hugin has biting lanterns.
choice:47:2:3.male: Of course Hugin has biting lanterns.
choice:47:2:3.female: Of course Hugin has biting lanterns.

say:50:1360005027:1.text: Hmph! Beats me! That boy's such a scaredy-cat.
say:50:1360005027:1.source_cn: 哼，没用的小子，人倒是老实，就是胆小！

choice:39:1:2.text: Why does Nate look so scared?
choice:39:1:2.male: Why does Nate look so scared?
choice:39:1:2.female: Why does Nate look so scared?

choice:21:0:1.male: What are the lanterns used for?
choice:21:0:1.female: What are the lanterns used for?

say:51:1360005009:1.text: My sweet Shimmy! Even though she's only Mark II right now, I swear I'll perfect her and bring her into this world just the way she's meant to be!
say:51:1360005009:1.source_cn: 我的小彩虹，虽然现在只是二号，但我发誓，我一定会让你完...
say:51:1360005009:1.male: My sweet Shimmy! Even though she's only Mark II right now, I swear I'll perfect her and bring her into this world just the way she's meant to be!

say:0:1360006001:2.text: Amid the chaos, you managed to wrestle the escaped damedanglers back under control and, with some help, finally got those overly feisty lanterns locked up again.
say:0:1360006001:2.source_cn: 一通手忙脚乱后，你们击败了逃跑的冥湾美人，并在其他人的...

say:3:1360006002:0.text: Hugin! Who in their right mind uses damedanglers as lanterns? And look how many of them you have!
say:3:1360006002:0.source_cn: 呼金！哪有用冥湾美人这么危险的生物做灯笼的！你甚至还养...

say:4:1360006003:0.text: Well, they seemed practical! I didn't expect them to get so cranky after a little time in captivity.
say:4:1360006003:0.source_cn: 嚯，至少它们很实用！只是没想到冥湾美人被圈养后会这么凶猛……

say:5:1360006004:0.text: Bols said they lure prey underwater with those glowing heads of theirs, so I thought, "Why not make some colorful lanterns?"
say:5:1360006004:0.source_cn: 波尔斯告诉我，它们在水底时，就是靠头顶的光源吸引猎物，...

say:6:1360006005:0.text: But, uh... here we are. Nate, take these damedanglers back to Bols, will you?
say:6:1360006005:0.source_cn: 没想到会出这种事，唉……奈普，你去把这些冥湾美人还给波...

say:7:1360006006:1.text: And this time, I'll make sure they're good and sedated. No more jailbreaks. As for lantern materials... I'll think of something safer.
say:7:1360006006:1.source_cn: 放心，这次我保证它们都先被麻醉了，路上不会再挣脱束缚。...

say:10:1360006008:0.text: And you two. Thanks for your help with that!
say:10:1360006008:0.source_cn: 这次也多亏你们帮忙了，小伙子们！

say:14:1360006009:1.text: Uh, no problem! We were just, uh, passing through. And we almost "lost" your goods, too. It's the least we could do.
say:14:1360006009:1.source_cn: 呃，没有没有，我们就是顺路，顺路那什么，“损耗”一下，...

say:15:1360006010:1.text: Yeah, yeah! Just don't go reporting us to the Carmine Whispers, okay? We're all good here!
say:15:1360006010:1.source_cn: 是啊是啊，你不把我们举报到血薇帮那里就谢天谢地了。

say:16:1360006011:1.text: If that's all, we'll head out now! There are still lots of good to be moved at the port.
say:16:1360006011:1.source_cn: 没事的话我们就先走了，港口还有不少货等着搬呢。

say:18:1360006013:1.text: You don't want to make lanterns anymore? Here, take this roll of cloth. I'm feeling nice today.
say:18:1360006013:1.source_cn: 你们不是要拿彩布做彩灯吗，这一码给你们，再多可没有了！

say:19:1360006014:1.text: And no more stealing, you hear me? If I catch you again, I won't be so forgiving!
say:19:1360006014:1.source_cn: 但以后不准再来偷东西，否则再让我撞见，我绝对不会客气！

say:20:1360006015:1.text: T-this is amazing! If we'd known you were this generous, we wouldn't have touched your things at all!
say:20:1360006015:1.source_cn: 这、这可真是……！早知道你这么心善，我们就不合理“损耗”了！

say:21:1360006016:1.text: Let's go, let's go! Don't wait for the kind-hearted craftsman to change his mind! Thank you!
say:21:1360006016:1.source_cn: 快走吧快走吧，别等我们善心的工匠先生临时改了主意！谢谢了！

say:22:1360006017:1.text: And good luck with, uh, the Emberlight Festival!
say:22:1360006017:1.source_cn: 也祝你那什么——春焰庆顺利！

say:23:1360006018:1.text: Hugin shakes his head as they accept the fabric and practically skip away, grinning ear to ear.
say:23:1360006018:1.source_cn: 两个人推脱几句，还是收下了彩布，欢天喜地地离开了。

say:26:1360006019:0.text: Hugin, you've given away the cloth and lost your lanterns. What are you going to do about... uh, Shimmy?
say:26:1360006019:0.source_cn: 呼金，你把布和灯都送走了，那你的女儿——“彩虹”怎么办？

say:27:1360006020:0.text: *Sigh* I'm still thinking about it. Honestly, I wasn't sold on those fabrics for Shimmy anyway. I want her to shine!
say:27:1360006020:0.source_cn: 唉，我也在想呢。其实本来我就觉得，这些彩布不一定能让我...

say:28:1360006021:0.text: Oh! Speaking of, I still owe you for those parts. Let's get that settled.
say:28:1360006021:0.source_cn: 对了对了，你们拿来的零件钱我还没付呢，先落袋为安！

choice_prompt:29:1360006021.source_cn: 对了对了，你们拿来的零件钱我还没付呢，先落袋为安！

say:30:1360006022:0.text: Haha, well, these parts are in high demand, and I'd say they're worth it!
say:30:1360006022:0.source_cn: 哈哈，现在这些零件可是紧俏得很，我也算是捡了点便宜！

say:31:1360006023:1.text: With them, Shimmy might not have the flashiest look, but she'll pack a punch where it counts.
say:31:1360006023:1.source_cn: 有了这些，就算彩虹外表不够出众，至少战斗力不会输吧……

say:33:1360006025:1.source_cn: 薄暮丛林中央的流荧树即便在夜晚也会发光，瓦度索山脉的情...

say:34:1360006026:1.text: Maybe our Wilder friends could help with the decorations. That would make things easier for Hugin, right?

say:37:1360006027:1.text: Alright, Chippy will bring this money back to Marilee. Why don't you and Hammie head to the Dark Forest?
say:37:1360006027:1.source_cn: 那，这些钱我就先去交给梅瑞特，漫漫，你陪主人去薄暮丛林？

say:41:1360006028:1.text: Don't worry, Chippy will bring this money back to her and then meet you at the Dark Forest!
say:41:1360006028:1.source_cn: 好，我去送钱给梅瑞特，我们到时候在薄暮丛林会合！

say:15:1360007013:1.text: Granny Dahnie finishes giving her instructions and heads off. As soon as she's out of sight, Damian's eyes light up, and he leans in with excitement.
say:15:1360007013:1.source_cn: 达赫妮婆婆又叮嘱了几句，这才离开。她前脚刚走，后脚达米...

say:16:1360007014:0.text: You're here at the perfect time! That's right, Damian the Great Inventor is about to show off his latest and greatest masterpiece!
say:16:1360007014:0.source_cn: 你们来的正是时候！没错，大发明家达米安正好要给你们展示...

say:17:1360007015:1.text: Behold! The magnificent, awe-inspiring Floralis Nexus Mark III, a true marvel of unparalleled brilliance!
say:17:1360007015:1.source_cn: 看！诸翼祝福的青藤之心三号改良版！

say:18:1360007016:0.text: ... Okay, maybe he's being a little over the top, but it's basically just like Hugin's "Shimmerwing Reinforced Hyperflux Mark II".
say:18:1360007016:0.source_cn: ……虽然名字风格稍微诗意一点，但这个取名形式，和呼金的...

say:20:1360007017:1.text: Well, I-I was worried you might forget something important, so I write everything down in my super special notebook...
say:20:1360007017:1.source_cn: 哎呀，我、我怕你忘记重要的事情，所以一直带着随身的记事本……

say:21:1360007018:0.text: Wait, no, that's not the point! The important part is the decorations for the festival...
say:21:1360007018:0.source_cn: 不不不，这些不重要！重要的是春焰庆的彩灯和装饰——

say:22:1360007019:0.text: Nooo! The most important thing is the Golem Forgemaster Contest at the festival!
say:22:1360007019:0.source_cn: 不，更重要的是春焰庆上的伊索米亚机械模拟仿真动物制作大赛！

say:23:1360007020:0.text: Hmph, don't underestimate me just because the dwarves always win! This year's gonna be totally different—because I'm in it!
say:23:1360007020:0.source_cn: 哼，别看一直以来大赛冠军都被矮人垄断，但是今年可就不一...

say:24:1360007021:0.text: That's right! I, Damian of the Dark Forest—and my awesome creation, the Floralis Nexus!
say:24:1360007021:0.source_cn: 来自薄暮丛林的达米安——与他引以为豪的青藤之心！

choice_prompt:25:1360007021.text: That's right! I, Damian of the Dark Forest—and my awesome creation, the Floralis Nexus!
choice_prompt:25:1360007021.source_cn: 来自薄暮丛林的达米安——与他引以为豪的青藤之心！

say:26:1360007022:0.text: It's where machines meet woodcraft, and creative ideas mix with awesome skill! Of course I know about it—I'm a future genius in the making, after all!
say:26:1360007022:0.source_cn: 伊索米亚机械模拟仿真动物制作大赛！一场机械与木艺，灵感...

say:27:1360007023:0.text: He's starting to sound eerily like Hugin...
say:27:1360007023:0.source_cn: 甚至连口号都和呼金说的一样……

say:28:1360007026:0.text: The Emberlight Festival used to be all about dressing up in giant beast costumes and fighting in them.
say:28:1360007026:0.source_cn: 从大众传统上来说，装扮成巨兽玩乐甚至比武，这是春焰庆常...

say:29:1360007027:0.text: I heard the Maulers don't even bother with costumes and just jump straight into the brawling!
say:29:1360007027:0.source_cn: 听说蛮血部落甚至有不做打扮，直接亲自上台搏击比武的改良...

say:30:1360007028:0.text: But things are different now! We're in an era where invention, mechanics, and creativity come together to spark a whole new brilliance!
say:30:1360007028:0.source_cn: 但！时代已经改变了，如今是发明、机械与创意结合，迸发出...

say:31:1360007029:0.text: The contest has been around for years, and it's mostly dwarves with their big, clunky designs that win. But this time, this time, we Wilders will show them what true genius looks like!
say:31:1360007029:0.source_cn: 大赛举行了这么多年，往年获得冠军的基本都是矮人那些笨重...

say:33:1360007030:1.text: Wow, Hugin said this contest was super niche. Chippy didn't expect you to be one of the participants!
say:33:1360007030:1.source_cn: 我记得呼金说过，这赛事十分小众，没想到达米安竟然是参与...

say:34:1360007031:1.text: Maybe it's not as unheard of as we thought...
say:34:1360007031:1.source_cn: 也许也没我们想得那么小众……

say:35:1360007032:0.text: Anyway, I've made up my mind! This year, I'm going to blow away those dwarves with my Floralis Nexus!
say:35:1360007032:0.source_cn: 总之，我决定这次让耀光的矮人们看看来自薄暮丛林的天才设计！

say:36:1360007033:0.text: My golem has an essence that those clunky machines can't even begin to rival!
say:36:1360007033:0.source_cn: 我的青藤之心有着那些笨重机械无可比拟的本质！

say:37:1360007034:0.text: It's not just flexible because of plant magic—it's alive! The materials are still growing, still living. Their clunky machines can't even dream of doing that!
say:37:1360007034:0.source_cn: 除了使用植物魔法进行操控的灵活性外，我用来制作青藤之心...

choice_prompt:38:1360007034.text: It's not just flexible because of plant magic—it's alive! The materials are still growing, still living. Their clunky machines can't even dream of doing that!
choice_prompt:38:1360007034.source_cn: 除了使用植物魔法进行操控的灵活性外，我用来制作青藤之心的材料甚至还保持着活性，这可是了不起的壮举！

say:39:1360007035:0.text: Yep! I convinced Petal, my glimmerbloom friend, to lend a hand and give me some vines. And that's not all—
say:39:1360007035:0.source_cn: 没错，我说服了一叶——我的荧荧花朋友——从旁协助，提供...

say:41:1360007037:0.text: As Damian rambles on, his half-finished mechanical beast suddenly springs to life! Its tendrils whip out with a loud whap, and the thing reveals its full form.
say:41:1360007037:0.source_cn: 达米安还在滔滔不绝地讲述着，他身旁的半成品巨兽突然哗啦...

say:42:1360007038:0.text: Why is it that inventors always end up getting attacked by their own creations?!
say:42:1360007038:0.source_cn: ——为什么你们这些发明家都会被自己的造物袭击啊！

say:44:1360007036:0.text: That's normal! The materials are alive, after all.
say:44:1360007036:0.source_cn: 这很正常，因为材料本身就是活的——

choice:25:0:1.source_cn: 呃，你怎么也知道那个比赛

say:45:1360007024:0.text: It's a big deal. It's where the best of the best come together, refine their craft, and share groundbreaking ideas!
say:45:1360007024:0.source_cn: 不！那是真正最顶尖的爱好者们才会精研与碰头的聚会！

say:46:1360007025:0.text: Still sounds kind of niche to me!

choice:19:0:1.source_cn: 天啊，你竟然记住了彩虹的名字！

choice:19:1:2.text: Do you have a photographic memory?
choice:19:1:2.male: Do you have a photographic memory?
choice:19:1:2.female: Do you have a photographic memory?

say:1:1360008001:0.text: Ah! It didn't get damaged, did it?
say:1:1360008001:0.source_cn: 诶呀！不会受到损伤了吧！

say:2:1360008002:0.text: Whew, it's fine! The Floralis Nexus structure's still holding up.
say:2:1360008002:0.source_cn: ……还好还好，青藤之心的结构没什么大问题。

say:3:1360008003:1.text: Attack performance... eh, decent. How's the limb balance looking? Petal, help me out here, will you?
say:3:1360008003:1.source_cn: 攻击性能……尚可，肢体平衡性呢……？一叶，你帮忙看看好不好？

say:9:1360008007:1.text: Damian... weren't you all grumpy about the Maulers skipping the costume tradition and going straight to battle?
say:9:1360008007:1.source_cn: 达米安……你说过，蛮血部落有人懒得扮演怪兽，直接自己上...

say:10:1360008008:1.text: But here you are, skipping tradition too! Wrapping a living glimmerbloom in a mechanical shell... This isn't even engineering anymore.
say:10:1360008008:1.source_cn: 可直接和活的荧荧花合作，在外面组装外壳……先不谈创意，...

say:11:1360008009:1.text: It's more like... a magical creature performance than a true test of your invention skills.
say:11:1360008009:1.source_cn: 相比大发明家，更像是和魔法生物配合的演出……

say:14:1360008012:1.text: I guess I got so caught up in chasing after creativity and flair that I kinda forgot what inventing is really about.
say:14:1360008012:1.source_cn: 是我之前过于追求绿裔特色和创意，结果反而走上了歧途，忘...

say:15:1360008013:1.text: Thanks for the wake-up call! I'm gonna rebuild the Floralis Nexus!
say:15:1360008013:1.source_cn: 谢谢你们的帮忙和提醒！我打算重建青藤之心！

say:16:1360008014:1.text: Even the simplest bit of woodworking, when mixed with my magic and imagination, will shine brighter than anything else in the world!
say:16:1360008014:1.source_cn: 再朴素的木工，有了我的创意与魔法，也绝对能焕发出独一无...

choice_prompt:17:1360008014.text: Even the simplest bit of woodworking, when mixed with my magic and imagination, will shine brighter than anything else in the world!
choice_prompt:17:1360008014.source_cn: 再朴素的木工，有了我的创意与魔法，也绝对能焕发出独一无二的光彩！

say:18:1360008015:1.text: Ambition's not enough! I gotta put it into action! Full research mode, here I come!
say:18:1360008015:1.source_cn: 光有志气还不够，必须要落实才行，我准备去闭关研发了！

say:19:1360008017:1.text: Oh, by the way, weren't you guys looking for unique lanterns and decorations?
say:19:1360008017:1.source_cn: 啊，对了，我记得你们是想找有特色的彩灯和染色装饰吧？

say:20:1360008018:1.text: We stick to the traditional ones here. I mean, we've got the Lucent Tree lighting up the whole place! Can't steal its spotlight, right?
say:20:1360008018:1.source_cn: 因为能仰望到流荧树，所以我们村中的装饰都比较传统，毕竟...

say:21:1360008019:1.text: And the glowing plants, animals, and bugs? They lose their color if they leave the forest. I tested it myself!
say:21:1360008019:1.source_cn: 周围栖息的会发光的动植物，乃至小昆虫，离开丛林后也会失...

say:22:1360008020:1.text: But I think Jade Lake Academy comes up with new lantern designs every year. Florabelle handles that kind of stuff.
say:22:1360008020:1.source_cn: 但据我所知，瓦度索山脉的翡湖学院每年都会制作和设计一些...

say:24:1360008021:0.text: Does the academy have courses on decorating?
say:24:1360008021:0.source_cn: 翡湖学院还有这种课程啊？

say:25:1360008022:1.text: They call it "aesthetic sense" and "understanding plant ecology". But come on, it's basically just arts and crafts for kids!
say:25:1360008022:1.source_cn: 说是要培养审美和对植物生态的理解，不过在我看来，就是小...

say:26:1360008023:1.source_cn: 明明你自己也是个小孩子……！

say:27:1360008024:1.text: I'm not like those mischievous brats—I'm the Great Inventor Damian!
say:27:1360008024:1.source_cn: 我和那些顽皮的小孩可不一样，我是大发明家达米安！

choice_prompt:28:1360008024.text: I'm not like those mischievous brats—I'm the Great Inventor Damian!
choice_prompt:28:1360008024.source_cn: 我和那些顽皮的小孩可不一样，我是大发明家达米安！

say:29:1360008027:0.text: Alright, I'm heading back to work on the Floralis Nexus Mark IV. If you're going to the academy, make sure you're back before dinner.
say:29:1360008027:0.source_cn: 好啦，我要去研发青藤之心四号了，你们如果要去学院，记得...

say:30:1360008028:0.text: Granny's cooking, and if you're late, I'm the one who'll get scolded!
say:30:1360008028:0.source_cn: 婆婆会做好晚饭等你们的！要是错过了婆婆的晚饭，挨骂的只...

say:32:1360008025:0.text: I'm not immature! I'm filled with creativity! Crea-ti-vity! Got it?
say:32:1360008025:0.source_cn: 对我来说，不算顽皮，叫富、有、创、意！

say:33:1360008026:0.text: It's not about age; it's about having a sharp mind and a clear vision!
say:33:1360008026:0.source_cn: 重点不在于年龄，而在于敏锐的头脑和眼界！

choice:28:2:3.text: It's cute how you act mature.
choice:28:2:3.source_cn: 只有小孩才会嚷嚷自己是大人
choice:28:2:3.male: It's cute how you act mature.
choice:28:2:3.female: It's cute how you act mature.

say:34:1360008016:1.text: Just you wait! The ultimate Floralis Nexus Mark IV is gonna blow your mind!
say:34:1360008016:1.source_cn: 等着看史上第一厉害的青藤之心四号吧！

choice:6:1:2.source_cn: 竟然真的是活的荧荧花！

narration:0:1360009001:1.text: You leave Lunadorf and make your way to Jade Lake Academy to visit Florabelle...
narration:0:1360009001:1.source_cn: 于是，你们离开月湖村，前往翡湖学院拜访芙拉贝尔……

say:3:1360009002:1.text: Alright, my little artists! Is everyone done with their lanterns?
say:3:1360009002:1.source_cn: 那么，孩子们，大家都做好小灯笼了吗？

say:4:1360009003:0.text: Finished ages ago! I was the first one done! Look, look!
say:4:1360009003:0.source_cn: 早就做完啦！第一个做完的！

say:6:1360009005:1.text: But hmm... I think there's still a little room for improvement. How about we cover the glue with some pretty leaves? It'll make it even nicer!
say:6:1360009005:1.source_cn: 不过仔细看看，很多地方可以做得更好呢，如果把接缝处的胶...

say:7:1360009006:1.text: Okay, okay... I'll fix it! I want it to be perfect, too!

say:10:1360009007:1.text: Teacher Florabelle, I finished mine too!
say:10:1360009007:1.source_cn: 我也做好啦，芙拉贝尔老师！

say:11:1360009008:1.text: Swifty's a bit slower, but oh so careful. Let me see... Hmmm, I think the frame could use a little more strength. That way, if you hang it up, the wind won't blow it away.
say:11:1360009008:1.source_cn: 乐乐的速度稍微慢了点，但做得仔细多了，我看看……灯笼骨...

say:12:1360009009:1.text: Got it! I'll make it perfect, promise!
say:12:1360009009:1.source_cn: 没问题！我的灯笼一定精益求精！

say:15:1360009010:1.text: U-um... I'm still not done yet...

say:16:1360009011:1.text: Oh, Smashy, yours is so detailed! You're taking your time, and that's okay. Just don't get stuck on tiny things. Try finishing the whole lantern first, and then we can perfect the details!
say:16:1360009011:1.source_cn: 困困做得非常精致！慢工出细活，但可以不用太局限于细节，...

say:18:1360009012:0.text: I've got one ready as an example for you all! Watch closely, okay?
say:18:1360009012:0.source_cn: 来，这是老师做好的，大家来模仿着学习一下——

say:19:1360009013:1.text: Oh! Look who's here—<style="stress"><player_name></style>, along with Chippy and Hammie! Welcome, welcome! Are you here to make some flower lanterns too?

say:20:1360009014:1.text: Come on, come on! Take a look at the lanterns we just finished!
say:20:1360009014:1.source_cn: 来，正好看看我们刚刚完成的花朵灯笼——

say:23:1360009015:1.text: Look! I fixed it! My lantern's all better now!
say:23:1360009015:1.source_cn: 我已经补好了！看！我的灯笼！

say:26:1360009016:0.text: Mine's super cute, don't you think?

say:32:1360009018:0.text: Aww, these lanterns are so adorable! They really show off the style of this region!
say:32:1360009018:0.source_cn: 好可爱的小灯笼！而且还很有这边的特色！

say:35:1360009019:0.text: Aren't they just the sweetest? The kids made these all by themselves. I've been helping them out these past few days, and they've done such a great job!

say:39:1360009021:0.text: Huh? You don't want to learn how to make one of these? It's so easy and fun!
say:39:1360009021:0.source_cn: 咦？不来学学这种小灯笼的做法吗？很简单的哦。

say:40:1360009022:1.text: You tell Florabelle what you're planning and ask if she has any decorations or materials that would work for Hugin.
say:40:1360009022:1.source_cn: 你们向芙拉贝尔说明来意，并询问她是否能给一些适合呼金的...

say:41:1360009023:1.text: So you're making decorations for a... replica monster? Hmm, not sure if it'll fit with the dwarves' style, but I've got plenty of special stuff here!
say:41:1360009023:1.source_cn: 原来如此，为仿真怪兽做装饰啊……虽然不知道是否适合矮人...

say:42:1360009024:1.text: Since the final test for the school year is so close to the Emberlight Festival, lots of students make all kinds of things.
say:42:1360009024:1.source_cn: 学校的落叶季测试时间距离春焰庆很近，所以许多学生会产出...

say:43:1360009025:1.text: Special flowers, magical fabrics, and even yummy foods! After the test, they either show off their work at the academy or take it home.
say:43:1360009025:1.source_cn: 比如特别的花朵、魔法染色的布料，也有各类美食——在评分...

say:46:1360009027:1.text: Hehe, I'll gladly accept your help! Do you all know the legend of the Emberlight Festival?
say:46:1360009027:1.source_cn: 呵呵呵，那我就不客气了。几位，你们都知道春焰庆的传说吧？

say:49:1360009028:1.text: Oh, is it the one where a monster attacks humans, and the humans disguise themselves as a fake monster to fight back with fireworks?
say:49:1360009028:1.source_cn: 就是怪兽袭击凡人，被凡人伪装成假怪兽，用烟火击退的故事吗？

say:51:1360009030:1.text: They'll love it, and it'll boost their confidence!
say:51:1360009030:1.source_cn: 这样能帮助他们建立自信。

say:52:1360009031:1.text: Of course! Sir Chippy is at your service!

say:53:1360009032:1.text: I'm here to help too! Let's show them how it's done!
say:53:1360009032:1.source_cn: 和见习魔法师漫漫——愿意帮助孩子们！

choice:45:1:2.text: Let me do something in return!
choice:45:1:2.male: Let me do something in return!

say:39:1360014031:0.text: Please don't talk like that, Archon. A Celestial's gift ending up in the wrong hands is no small matter.
say:39:1360014031:0.source_cn: 不，塔琳女士，半神的赠礼流落在外可不是小事。

say:40:1360014032:1.text: If the local underground networks catch wind of this, we'll be in for a world of trouble. People with... less noble intentions will start turning their attention to Holistone, and we can kiss the town's peace goodbye.
say:40:1360014032:1.source_cn: 要是被附近的黑市和暗线知道，不怀好意的目光投射到圣石镇...

say:41:1360014033:1.text: Don't worry, though. I'll round up a team and track it down. We'll have your precious gift back in no time. The Emberlight Festival will go off without a hitch!
say:41:1360014033:1.source_cn: 我去带队搜查，把你们珍贵的礼物拿回来——无论如何，我希...

say:42:1360014034:1.text: Oh, then I'll offer my help too!

choice:38:0:1.source_cn: 诶呀，我更想要原来那份……

say:3:1360015001:1.text: We finally got it back... I can't believe someone had the nerve to steal from a Celestial!
say:3:1360015001:1.source_cn: 总算拿回来了……！竟然真的有扒手会对尊贵的半神动手！

say:4:1360015002:1.text: My apologies. You know how it goes—during festivals in Holistone, petty thefts always seem to skyrocket, and we knights are stuck with endless complaints.
say:4:1360015002:1.source_cn: 见笑了，每逢节日，圣石镇往来的小偷小摸都会增加不少，骑...

say:5:1360015003:0.text: Especially during the Emberlight Festival. Once Brightening the Sky starts, it feels like trouble never takes a break.
say:5:1360015003:0.source_cn: 春焰庆更是要命，等到开阳阶段，那可就堪称无穷无尽了。

say:6:1360015004:1.text: Do you think it's because of the markets here?
say:6:1360015004:1.source_cn: 是因为集市期间会有更多纠纷吗？

say:7:1360015005:1.text: Not only that. After night falls, it's a constant barrage of complaints—fireworks too loud, lanterns too bright, people can't sleep...
say:7:1360015005:1.source_cn: 不止那些，还有夜幕降临之后，总有镇民投诉烟火太吵，灯光...

say:8:1360015006:1.text: And let's not even talk about the kids setting off fireworks in the alleys. They're scaring the elderly, the little ones, the pets, and even the horses. It's chaos!
say:8:1360015006:1.source_cn: 或者是孩童突然在街巷燃放的烟火，老人、孩子、宠物、马匹...

say:9:1360015007:1.text: But if you ask the shopkeepers to turn off their lights or keep the fireworks just in the square, it's a tough sell. After all, it's a festival, right? Even if we stick rules everywhere, people break them anyway.
say:9:1360015007:1.source_cn: 但你去劝商家店铺关上灯，或是只能在广场放烟火，也没什么...

say:10:1360015008:1.text: So to keep the knights from completely burning out, General Hogan and I step in to keep the peace—balance things out as best as we can.
say:10:1360015008:1.source_cn: 为了不让骑士团的人过于疲累，就只能我和霍根将军到处卖卖...

say:11:1360015009:0.text: It's manageable for about three to five days. Any longer? I'd hand in my sword!
say:11:1360015009:0.source_cn: 不过也还好，一般也就那么三五天，要是再长，我就只能辞职...

choice_prompt:12:1360015009.text: It's manageable for about three to five days. Any longer? I'd hand in my sword!
choice_prompt:12:1360015009.source_cn: 不过也还好，一般也就那么三五天，要是再长，我就只能辞职不干了！

say:13:1360015010:1.text: Oh, it was twenty days once... maybe decades ago.
say:13:1360015010:1.source_cn: 啊，曾经是有过二十天的时候吧，大概几十年前？

say:16:1360015011:1.text: Decades ago... Has it truly been that long?
say:16:1360015011:1.source_cn: 几十年前……已经过去那么久了？

say:17:1360015012:1.text: I can see it... Keeping lanterns burning bright for twenty days straight feels a bit too much for the mortal world of today.
say:17:1360015012:1.source_cn: 确实，连续二十天彻夜不熄的灯光，对于现在的凡间来说有些...

say:20:1360015014:1.text: Oh, there's an exception. On the final night of March to Dawn, when it transitions into Brightening the Sky, the fireworks are absolutely essential.
say:20:1360015014:1.source_cn: 啊，没错，逐夜的最后一夜，抵达开阳之日的夜晚，那一天必...

say:21:1360015016:1.text: With the help of the Serene Lyceum, the Lightbearer Empire's fireworks are unrivaled in both color and scale. No one else even comes close.
say:21:1360015016:1.source_cn: 有莱希拉姆魔法学院的帮忙，耀光帝国的烟火花色和规模可谓...

say:22:1360015017:0.text: But hey, at the end of the day, fireworks are just fireworks. Still, I can't help but think... if only a beautiful flame could light up the first night of Brightening the Sky...
say:22:1360015017:0.source_cn: 不过嘛，归根结底那还是烟火，我想，如果有美丽的火焰可以...

say:23:1360015018:0.text: I can imagine! In the pitch-black night, a dazzling flame ignites first, illuminating Dura's statue in Holistone—
say:23:1360015018:0.source_cn: 在漆黑的夜晚，无比耀眼的火焰率先燃起，照亮圣石镇的女神像——

say:25:1360015020:1.text: I can soar through the vast heavens, carrying flames as brilliant as the sun, bringing forth a rare and breathtaking sight to this world.
say:25:1360015020:1.source_cn: 我可以像托起太阳那样带着火焰划过夜空，带来世间难得一见...

say:26:1360015021:1.text: When the time arrives, let me lead everyone through March to Dawn, guiding them into the brilliance of the coming dawn!
say:26:1360015021:1.source_cn: 到时候就让我来带领大家，度过逐夜的夜晚吧！

say:28:1360015015:1.text: Exactly! Though the following days do spark some disputes, the fireworks on March to Dawn evening? No one can argue with that.
say:28:1360015015:1.source_cn: 正是如此，虽然后面几天经常会有纠纷，但逐夜当夜的烟火，...

say:0:1360016001:2.text: On the night of the March to Dawn, you gather with the residents of Holistone beneath Dura's statue to welcome the arrival of Brightening the Sky.
say:0:1360016001:2.source_cn: “逐夜”当晚，你们齐聚一堂，在女神像下，与圣石镇的居民...

say:3:1360016002:0.text: How wonderful to see you, old friend! I didn't think you'd make it back for the holidays.
say:3:1360016002:0.source_cn: 还以为会错过你们呢，老朋友。

say:4:1360016003:1.text: Oh, you don't know the Magister as well as you think, General! No matter the festival, he always finds a way to come back and join the fun!
say:4:1360016003:1.source_cn: 你还不了解主人吗，将军！无论什么节日，<male>他<...
say:4:1360016003:1.male: Oh, you don't know the Magister as well as you think, General! No matter the festival, he always finds a way to come back and join the fun!
say:4:1360016003:1.female: Oh, you don't know the Magister as well as you think, General! No matter the festival, she always finds a way to come back and join the fun!

say:5:1360016004:1.text: With some new friends every time!
say:5:1360016004:1.source_cn: 而且还经常会为我们带来一些新朋友，哈哈哈哈。

say:8:1360016005:0.text: I am prepared to bring the flames of dawn to all.
say:8:1360016005:0.source_cn: 我已经准备好给大家带来晨曦的焰光了。

say:10:1360016006:1.text: It's almost time! Everyone, prepare for the countdown!
say:10:1360016006:1.source_cn: 啊，快到时间了！大家，准备倒计时！

narration:13:1360016008:1.text: Just as the countdown reaches its end, a brilliant streak of light suddenly streaks across the sky, interrupting Talene before she can move.
narration:13:1360016008:1.source_cn: 在倒计时结束的瞬间，一道绚丽无比的流光居然抢在塔琳之前...

say:15:1360016009:1.text: Wait... Is that Dionel's spear? He beat me to it! What a show-off!
say:15:1360016009:1.source_cn: 那是萨基塔里斯的长矛？！居然被他抢先了！那个爱出风头的家伙！

say:16:1360016010:1.text: Refusing to be outdone, Talene sends a brilliant, swirling flame soaring into the sky.
say:16:1360016010:1.source_cn: 塔琳不甘示弱，下一秒，无比鲜艳的华美火焰盘旋破空而上……

say:19:1360016011:1.text: And then, as the crowd erupts in cheers, the fireworks explode in a stunning display—
say:19:1360016011:1.source_cn: 随即，在大家的欢呼声中，烟火燃起——

say:21:1360016012:0.text: Brightening the Sky is here at last!

say:25:1360016013:1.text: Just wait til you see my fireworks; they're incredible! Hoho!
say:25:1360016013:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈哈，我的大烟花就是不一样！

say:26:1360016014:1.source_cn: 春焰庆快乐啊，呼金大人！

say:31:1360016015:1.text: Let's light those lanterns and celebrate Brightening the Sky!

say:37:1360016018:1.source_cn: 今年的烟花真是与众不同啊。

say:41:1360016019:0.text: Come on, stop standing there, you fools! Get up and keep fighting!
say:41:1360016019:0.source_cn: 别愣着，你们这帮笨蛋，继续上啊！

say:42:1360016020:1.text: The warriors of the Grimmaw Clan might be down for now, but they'll be back!
say:42:1360016020:1.source_cn: 现在黑嚎部族的战士暂时处于劣势——

say:47:1360016021:1.text: Look at that! Lumont is going to paint all of this!
say:47:1360016021:1.source_cn: 好漂亮，噜噜要画好多画！

say:48:1360016022:1.text: Hehe, you love it, right? This year's fireworks are all because of me!
say:48:1360016022:1.source_cn: 嘿嘿，好看吧？这次的烟火可有我的功劳！

say:51:1360016023:1.text: Hmph, not bad... I wonder what Temesia's up to right now...
say:51:1360016023:1.source_cn: 哼，还挺漂亮的嘛，不知道特弥希娅那家伙现在在干什么……

say:54:1360016024:1.text: Grandpa, Grandma, come outside! The fireworks are starting!
say:54:1360016024:1.source_cn: 爷爷，奶奶，放烟花了，快出来看！

say:61:1360016026:0.text: The Emberlight Festival has begun—Happy Emberlight Festival to all!
say:61:1360016026:0.source_cn: 春焰庆正式开始了——春焰庆快乐啊，各位！

narration:66:1360016029:0.text: As the dazzling fireworks light up the sky and laughter fills the air, you welcome the dawn of a new day...
narration:66:1360016029:0.source_cn: 在绚丽的烟花与欢声笑语中，你们迎来了新一日的晨曦……

narration:67:1360016030:1.text: This year's Emberlight Festival is going to be the best one yet!
narration:67:1360016030:1.source_cn: 今年的春焰庆，也会无比欢乐！
